__comment: EXAMPLE/DEV rules (vanilla-only, so they work in the standalone run). A 'to' rule is an automatic swap applied at placement to the exact block/tag it names (oak_planks->spruce_planks, cobblestone->mossy_cobblestone). A 'to_tag' rule is an INTERACTIVE candidate pool: the GUI 'Replace' picker shows a row per matching source block and lets the player pick a replacement from that tag. NOTE: a published library normally ships NO active rules (these would rewrite everyone's blueprints); delete this file for a clean library and let consumers supply rules under data/<their_namespace>/block_substitutions/.
